summary: Do this once, before Day 1. Everything here is free and takes about 30 minutes. Sign in first (you already have), so your checklist is saved while you tick each step. This day does not lock anything: if you already have the tools, tick them and move on.

items.text: Sign in on this page and bookmark it, so your progress is saved
Install Git, then open a terminal and run git --version
Install Visual Studio Code (or the editor you like best)
Install uv, then run uv --version (uv can install Python for you)
Run uv python install 3.12, then uv run --python 3.12 python --version
Create a folder for your work, open it in your editor, and open a terminal inside it
